notes.title: NSG: new update - versão 1.1
notes.content:
Hello,

We have shipped a new update for NSG. Check out the changelog below.

NSG - version 1.1:

[list]
[*] Preparation of the base game to receive the code for the DLC [b]Missing Tales![/b], to be released in 2023;
[*] Cosmetic changes to the game's title screen;
[*] Added link to [b]Missing Tales![/b]'s Steam store page on title screen.
[/list]

Thank you and have fun!
